scope: 26 item IDs (4 ARC, 22 HellaSwag) excluded wherever they occur in the 13,494-file core raw scan, following the outcome-independent ambiguity policy
rule: for every archived member, remove every row whose item_id appears in mask_ids[bench]; keep the remaining rows in their original order and with their original values; keep scalar metadata unchanged except n_kept (= post-mask row count); add the four correction provenance scalars (correction_policy_id, correction_source_sha256, correction_n_removed, correction_removed_ids, the last being the removed IDs in file order joined by newlines); write with the byte-deterministic npz writer

corrected_view_reference.role: Corrected raw view for source recomputation
corrected_view_reference.aggregate_definition: sha256 over sorted '<bench>/<filename> <sha256 of the corrected npz>' lines

reader_path.note: the tool verifies every source file against RAW_INPUT_MANIFEST.json before reading it and fails closed on any source or output mismatch
